Your first notebook

A notebook holds pages that your colleagues can read and edit.

Create a notebook

  1. Open your workspace.
  2. Choose New notebook.
  3. Enter a name and save.

Invite a colleague

Open Members, enter an address and choose the Reader or Editor role.

Write a page

Start with a heading, then record the decisions from your meeting.

# Weekly notes

Attendees: Mira and Rowan
Decision: Move the planning meeting to Tuesday.

Export your notes

Choose Export in the notebook menu to download an archive.

Control and S save the current page.
